note: Bed Management Processes is drawn by a copy of the latest Solutions generator pointed at Processes (bm_processes_html.py), with the library's Processes motifs layered (the ward board, magnets, name badges, chairs, instrument windows, the trial strip, the loop) and five drawings of its own (bm_pr_blocks.py), all in the look of the approved Processes landing page: B, the trial ward (pale clay, deep brown, rust, pill buttons).

theme.name: Bed Management · Processes: the trial ward

tones.rule: The background changes every four turns: turns 1–4 the day shift (floor tiles), 5–8 the evening shift (dots), 9–11 the day shift. Specs store no colour.

variety.rule: Every turn looks different (rules/08 §2). The main block is used by one turn only in Solutions; no block but heading and effect in two turns in a row.

actions.rule: rules/08 §8: the three buttons on every turn. Processes jumps back to Diagnosis.

blocks.from: library heading (Processes), with the ward board from the Processes landing page
blocks.purpose: Eyebrow, title and deck, with a small ward board: which column of the board this turn is about.
Each step of the day, its magnet moved from today to with the changes.
use_when: what changes on the ward, step by step
blocks.interaction: Pick a step to open it. Move one magnet, or all of them with the switch.

blocks.purpose: The two weeks on one ward: the day strip you can play, the phases as pickable bands, the ward still to choose.
blocks.interaction: Pick a phase, or play the two weeks. Type the ward you choose.

blocks.purpose: Name badges on the board, grouped by what each person does: who agrees, who is still to ask, who has a worry.
use_when: who has to agree, team by team
blocks.interaction: Pick a badge to open it. Filter by the trial or still to ask.

blocks.purpose: The roles as chairs, their triggers as lamps, the busy-hours check as a day strip with a slider.
use_when: whether to hire, and how many
blocks.interaction: Pick a role to open it. Move the slider and switch the sizing rule.

blocks.purpose: The measures as instrument windows: the starting number where there is one, dashed where nobody has one yet.
blocks.interaction: Pick a window to open it. Filter by when it is read; flip to after the trial.

blocks.purpose: Plan, try, measure, adjust, spread: a wheel with a yes-or-no check that sends you on or back.
blocks.interaction: Step round, or pick a step. At the check, answer yes or not yet.

blocks.purpose: One normal day’s times on one line. Blank: the times are typed straight into the drawing. Filled: the times and the gaps between them.
blocks.interaction: Type a time on each step (blank), or pick a step to open it (filled).

blocks.purpose: The quantity the part is aimed at, named once. Its look changes from turn to turn: door plate, stamp, ticket, banner, meter.
use_when: the part has one number it moves
avoid_when: more than two in a turn

blocks.purpose: A few pinned drafting cards, each opening its sheet.
use_when: a handful of smaller items beside a main drawing
avoid_when: the main drawing of a turn
blocks.interaction: Pick a card to raise it and open its sheet.

blocks.from: new (bm_pr_blocks.py): a wall clock, 8 AM to 8 PM, with the library Processes switch (today or with the changes)
blocks.purpose: The ward's day on a clock: today's admission window against the new one, and the fixed times of the new day.
use_when: how the day changes on the wards
blocks.interaction: Switch between today and the new day. Pick a time to move the clock hand and open it.

blocks.from: new (bm_pr_blocks.py): the trial ward seen from above, from the approved Processes landing page B
blocks.purpose: Each change pinned in the room of the ward where it happens.
use_when: where on the ward each change happens
blocks.interaction: Pick a change to raise its pin on the ward plan and open it.

blocks.from: new (bm_pr_blocks.py): the doctor's round as patient cards, after the transcript's 'show a date to confirm or correct'
blocks.purpose: A card per patient with the predicted date the doctor confirms or changes on the round.
use_when: what a doctor does on the round
blocks.interaction: Pick a patient to open where the date comes from. Confirm the date, or change it and type the new one.

blocks.from: new (bm_pr_blocks.py): the OPD prescription as a paper slip, its lines pulled into the bed plan
blocks.purpose: Where planned admissions come from: each line of the OPD slip and what it feeds in the bed plan.
use_when: the OPD slip as the start of the bed plan
blocks.interaction: Pick a line to open it. Press the button to pull the slip into the bed plan.

blocks.from: new (bm_pr_blocks.py): a clipboard form, typed straight into the drawing (the tool layer's inline entries)
blocks.purpose: What we need from the hospital to start, each line typed in and added to the message.
use_when: asking for the numbers or names still missing
blocks.interaction: Type on each line. Every line typed is added to the chat message. Pick a line to see why it is needed.
